title: Statement Window of Retention Statements by Maturity Case Status
content:
## Statement window of a retention statement — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the statement window days of the retention statement follow the status of the loan's maturity case under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product and, in the extension period, its resolution deadline.

| Maturity case on the statement date | Statement window days |
|---|---|
| referred to foreclosure | 15 |
| in its extension period, with a resolution deadline on or after the statement date and fewer than 30 calendar days after it | the calendar days from the statement date to that resolution deadline |
| in its extension period with a resolution deadline 30 or more calendar days after the statement date, or before it, or with none | no shortening under this rule |
| due and payable | no shortening under this rule |

The figure of 30 is the plan's good-through period of calendar days.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Case | Window days |
|---|---|
| Extension period, deadline on the statement date itself | 0 |
| Extension period, deadline 12 days after the statement date | 12 |
| Extension period, deadline 29 days after the statement date | 29 |
| Extension period, deadline 30 days after the statement date | no shortening |
| Referred to foreclosure, any deadline | 15 |
